scope: Every original assertion retained: renderer candidate computations; Node expected comparisons. Observations snapshotted with captured native structuredClone after each case; undefined and reference identity preserved.

findCard reports column and index
unknown action types throw

parse handles + and * and ragged rows

render round-trips every level
walking moves the player and counts moves

win detection
